A check asking 'is this a well-formed item ID' accepts it, and so does one asking 'does any capsule contain it'. Only resolution against the capsule UNDER TEST refuses it. Two codes, because the answer both failed to cite its own evidence and cited something outside its scope -- and the two remedies are opposite, so collapsing them would hand the operator half a cure.
